title: Outstanding Thesis Award - Silver Medal
summary: Congratulations to Charles Joseph Hinolan, Mac Andre Javellana, Mari Salvador Lapuz, and Audrea Arjaemi Tabadero on receiving the Outstanding Thesis Award (Silver Medal) for their work, "A Lightweight Computer Vision Model for Camouflaged Crop Detection." This marks CIVI`s second Outstanding Thesis Award in the BSCS program and third award overall. Their research evaluates lightweight object detection strategies, including pruning and knowledge distillation, to balance accuracy and computational efficiency for real-world agricultural applications.
